message:
Using `on:click` to listen to the click event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onclick` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

`<svelte:component>` is deprecated in runes mode — components are dynamic by default
https://svelte.dev/e/svelte_component_deprecated

`active` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
https://svelte.dev/e/non_reactive_update
